correctness.rationale: Walsh characters on the even-parity group diagonalize Laplacian with eigenvalue 2|S|(n-|S|). Fourier inversion of an edge dipole gives signed potentials 0 on mixed distinguished bits and ±a_r on equal bits, with a_r positive integral strictly decreasing by even r. Counting three edge-flip classes gives absolute-current sum (2+4m)S_m+(m-1)U_m, S_m=1/[2(m+1)] and U_m=1/4. Edge transitivity makes every column equal; P=I-Q shifts the norm by 1-2 tr(Q)/|E|. Independently reconstructed exact-rational Laplace potentials and all edge currents for n=3..8 matched both formulas; this is finite corroboration of the analytic formula.

originality.rationale: Dilworth–Kutzarova–Ostrovskii Theorem 45 and Corollary 60 treat canonical projections on the *ordinary Hamming cube* (distance-one full cube) and give its distinct norm (n+1)/2, not distance-two edges inside a parity class. Their method and ordinary-cube results are credited. The halved cube has a different Laplacian spectrum and current geometry; no direct specialization is known, and a specialized halved-cube projection norm may be indexed elsewhere.
